translation.name: Biblica® Bayibuli Entukuvu, Endagaano Enkadde nʼEndagaano Empya ekwatiddwa ku katambi™

content: Bino bye bigambo bya Aguli mutabani wa Yake; obubaka bwe yawa bwe buno:

content.text: Bw’ati omusajja ono bwe yagamba Isiyeri, Isyeri ono ne Ukali.
Ddala Ayi Katonda wange nze nsinga obutategeera,
Ani eyali alinnye mu ggulu n’akka?
Ani eyali akuŋŋaanyiza empewo mu kibatu ky’engalo ze?
Ani eyali asibye amazzi mu kyambalo kye?
Erinnya lye y’ani, ne mutabani we y’ani?
Buli kigambo kya Katonda kya mazima,
era aba ngabo eri abo abamwesiga.
Ebintu bibiri bye nkusaba; Ayi Mukama,
naye ndiisanga emmere eya buli lunaku.
Era nnemenga okuba omwavu ne nziba,
ne nvumisa erinnya lya Katonda wange.
alemenga okukukolimira, naawe omusango ne gukusinga.
abo abeeraba ng’abatuukirivu bo mu maaso gaabwe,
n’ebeerayo abo abalina amannyo agali ng’ebitala,

content: Waliwo ebintu bisatu ebitakkuta, weewaawo bina ebitagamba nti, “Matidde,”
Amagombe, olubuto olugumba, ettaka eritakutta mazzi, n’omuliro ogutayogera nti, “Ebyo binaamala!”
Waliwo ebigambo bisatu eby’ekitalo ennyo gye ndi, weewaawo bina bye sitegeera:
Empungu engeri gye yeeyisaamu mu bbanga, n’omusota engeri gye gwewalulamu wakati mu mayinja, n’ekyombo gye kiseeyeeyamu ku nnyanja, n’engeri omusajja gye yeeyisaamu ng’ali n’embeerera.
Ensi ekankanira wansi w’ebintu bisatu weewaawo bina:
omuweereza bw’afuuka kabaka, n’omusirusiru bw’akutta emmere;
n’omukazi eyadibira mu ddya; n’omuweereza omuwala bw’afumbirwa bba wa mugole we.
Waliwo ebintu ebitono bina ku nsi, ebirina amagezi amangi ennyo.
Enkolooto bye biwuka ebitalina maanyi mangi, naye byeterekera emmere yaabyo mu kyeya;
obumyu busolo bunafu naye bwezimbira ennyumba zaabwo mu mayinja;
enzige tezirina kabaka, kyokka zitabaala zonna mu bibiina byazo;
omunya oyinza okugukwasa engalo, naye mu mbiri za bakabaka gusangibwamu.
Waliwo ebintu bisatu ebyesimba obulungi mu kitiibwa nga bitambula, weewaawo bina ebitambulira mu kitiibwa:
empologoma esinga ensolo zonna amaanyi era kabaka waazo, so tewali gy’esegulira yonna;
sseggwanga, n’embuzi ennume, ne kabaka eyeetooloddwa eggye lye.

content.text: Bw’oba ng’obadde okoze eby’obusirusiru ne weegulumiza,
okutankuula obusungu, bwe kutyo kuleeta entalo.
